lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in three primary horizontal rows between longitudinal ridges. Spatial distribution is semi-regular with clusters positioned in the centers of grid-like cells.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal longitudinal ridges to form a rectilinear grid. The largest circular blobs are centered within the vertical stripe segments between the ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal edge and dark shadows on the ventral edge, running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs scattered across the mid-section and trailing edge of the dorsal fin silhouette; patterns appear less organized than the lateral flank grid.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of small, low-luminance teleost fish is visible ventrally between the pectoral fin and the mid-body region.
